gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-glegoo: Precise and modern up top, with a tall belly in every letter. Blockletter's pipe-cleaner strokes do the wiry sketching, while Glegoo, a text serif, uses big counters for a refined, editorial texture.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-pridi: Marker-traced strokes with a tall, squat-bellied midsection in Blockletter. Pridi lets small letters stand almost capital-sized, with generous gaps where curves meet stems, so paragraphs move along refined and unhurried.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified Suwannaphum, a text serif, sits beneath Blockletter's wire-like monoline skeleton. Its tall, squared-off, woodblock-like lowercase and paperclip-open c give running text a sturdy, unhurried, editorial pace down the column.
gen-dafont-blockletter-mulish: Blockletter sketches its tall-bellied letters like a pencil that never presses harder, and Mulish takes over below in a sans. Mulish's horseshoe openings and short ascenders give the heading something sturdy beneath.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified and editorial, the body text stands tall on a high, squared-off x-height. Suwannaphum keeps its c open like a bent paperclip, so lines move easily beneath Bloody's big round bowls.
gen-dafont-capture-it-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans reads clean, with c ends pointing apart like open pincers and a stroke weight that never wavers. Capture It towers and shuts tight; Instrument Sans opens up and stays quiet.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-slabo-13px: Bookish and dignified, the body has large open counters, sitting beneath Conthrax and its wide-mouthed a. Slabo 13px keeps rounded letters clearly open, so a paragraph unspools like a single thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-instrument-sans: Conthrax is geometric and clean, with a wide-mouthed lowercase a. Instrument Sans stays unvarying in weight, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers, with barely any step up to capitals.
gen-dafont-conthrax-inter: Inter has counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open. Inter handles the quiet, tube-smooth work, while Conthrax goes geometric, its capitals barely taller than its tall lowercase bodies.
gen-dafont-conthrax-mulish: Mulish keeps its strokes uniform, with apertures like the open end of a horseshoe magnet. And Conthrax, geometric and clean, brings a wide-mouthed a and capitals that barely clear its lowercase.
